entities.name: Gupta Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Gupta Empire, a political institution in India during Post-Mauryan and Classical Period (320–550). Grew from Shunga and Shunga, Satavahana, and Kushan Kingdoms. Led to the emergence of Kalidasa writes Shakuntala and Meghaduta, masterpieces of Sanskrit literature.
